findings.summary: Canvas engine and state-machine interpreter are compared only by xbSimEmbeddedParity.test.ts: unit-constant input, 6 ticks, scalar, discrete solver.
Solver dispatch is written three times: XbridgesWorkspace.tsx stepLiveSolver, xbridgesWorker.ts, Solvers.runFixedStep; no test that they agree.
Canvas ode23/ode45/ode23tb are stepped with the fixed step and hard-coded tolerances; no error control. Decision D3: control error with the user's RelTol/AbsTol.
SolverOptions.solver admits ode113, ode23s, ode15s that no dispatcher implements. Decision D3: remove them from the type; unknown names keep UNSUPPORTED_SOLVER.
Only Step and three PT_ blocks declare zero crossings. Decision D2: add ZeroCrossingFn to SATURATION, DEADZONE, RELAY, SWITCH, Abs and the PWM carrier blocks.
SUM_JUNCTION has a codegen capability and no factory; DiagExtract, ExtractDiag, Diag have a factory and no capability entry of their own.
The canvas palette and the help/AI palette differ: 20 types only on the canvas palette, 55 only on the help palette (inventory.json: onCanvasPaletteOnly, onHelpPaletteOnly).
DIMENSION_MISMATCH and DATA_TYPE_MISMATCH on a connection are warnings. Decision D1: compile errors, as in Simulink.
docs/XBRIDGES_EMBEDDED_CODEGEN.md lists about 40 embedded-capable types and two solvers; the registry has 100 and three.
Embedded limits (fixed-step euler/rk4/discrete, no algebraic loops, vector 16, matrix 8) have no test on both sides of each boundary.
The parameter schema covers 74 of 290 block types; PARAMETER_* errors do not apply to the others.
174 blocks have no equation text in their factory; ratchet list in tests/fixtures/xbridges/known-gaps.json.
233 blocks have at least one port without a unit; ratchet list in tests/fixtures/xbridges/known-gaps.json.
56 blocks use port types outside XSignalType (control, object, data, load, boolean); the engine's type checks do not know them. Ratchet list in tests/fixtures/xbridges/known-gaps.json.

GAIN treats gain 0 (and -0) as 1: factory uses params.gain || 1 (BlockDefinitions.ts ~3783); confirmed by run, also with per-tick applyParameterUpdates: input 3 gives 3, Simulink gives 0. PRODUCT numInputs 0 becomes 2 the same way (~3797). Found by the WP-02 executor, confirmed by the verifier; the U7 sweep in WP-03 will look for the same pattern in every block.

Stiff solvers with an algebraic loop: y = 0.5*y + 1 feeding an Integrator, dt 0.1, stop 1 (expected integral 2): ode14x gives 51.588135932457256, ode23tb 1.7999999999948573; every other solver gives about 2. Canvas emulation gives the same. Found by the WP-02 verifier. Root causes (verifier): ode23tb is the XBV-026 mechanism (first step rejected, 9 x 0.2 = 1.8); ode14x is not Newton itself - the loop is warm-started only to algTol 1e-6, so f(t, x) drifts and the finite-difference Jacobian reads 0.5 instead of 0; with algTol 1e-10 it gives 2.

The canvas accumulates time (timeRef += stepNow) instead of t0 + n*dt; the test kit uses multiplication (plan 5.1). Against an accumulating emulation, signals differ at rounding level for 40 block types (verifier measured counts, not size). WP-12 measures the drift and pins the canvas rule.

28 stateful blocks are sorted by the engine as non-direct-feedthrough although their output depends on the current input (DERIVATIVE, HIGH_PASS_FILTER, MOVING_AVERAGE, KALMAN_FILTER, EXTENDED_KALMAN_FILTER, LMS, PID/FOC/field-weakening blocks, several ROBOT_VACUUM_* and DEM_DRUM). Result depends on block order: MOVING_AVERAGE window 1 placed before its source gives y = [0,1,0,1,0,1] for u = [1,0,1,0,1,1]. Fix per block: either declare directFeedthrough (true feedthrough in Simulink) or output the pre-update state (plant blocks). List: universal-gaps.json XBV-U14.

153 numeric parameters are replaced by their default when set to 0 because factories use `params.x || default`; the canvas rebuilds blocks through the factory on Play, so the user's 0 is lost (GAIN.gain is XBV-015). List: universal-gaps.json XBV-U7f; engine-level list XBV-U7 (5).

16 blocks mutate their state (or inputs/params) in place inside execute; solver stages then see already-updated state. ROBOT_VACUUM_FUSION with x_true = 1: euler 0.99795, rk4 0.9999998, ode45 about 1 (one update per step: 0.9547). List: XBV-U10.

Blocks throw inside execute (stopping the run with BLOCK_RUNTIME_FAULT): on default inputs 9 (MPC_CONTROLLER default Q 2x2 vs 1 output; MatrixConcat, MatrixSolve, SubMatrix on scalars; DEM_*; ROBOT_VACUUM_ERODE_MASK, THETA_STAR), on NaN/Inf 9, on a wrong value kind 29. Lists XBV-U1, XBV-U4, XBV-U5.

Undefined outputs or unreported NaN: 5 blocks alone with unconnected inputs (DEMUX out2 undefined stops a downstream Abs), 11 blocks on finite edge inputs. Lists XBV-U2, XBV-U3. SECTOR_SELECTOR moved to XBV-025.
15 noise/stochastic blocks use unseeded Math.random: runs are not repeatable (Simulink noise blocks are seeded). With a fixed seed, state also survives a clone (U11 clean). List XBV-U9.

PWM_GENERATOR logs to the console inside execute and uses a golden-ratio phase offset; MPC_CONTROLLER keeps a class instance in state that does not survive a clone (hidden while it throws). Found during WP-03 triage. Severity raised from S4 (verifier): the PWM phase offset changes numbers and the MPC state is lost on clone; both are checked against oracles in WP-08 and WP-07.

SECTOR_SELECTOR returns sector -3 for theta = -10 rad (closed form floor(mod(theta, 2*pi)/(pi/3)) + 1 = 3); angles below -2*pi are not wrapped. Correct on (-2*pi, 4*pi). Pinned by it.fails in xbUniversal.test.ts.

Canvas ode23tb freezes silently: the canvas and worker call StiffSolver.stepODE23TB once per output step with tolerances 1e-3/1e-6 and ignore { accepted: false }; a rejected step leaves the state unchanged with no diagnostic. On x' = -1e4 x the state stays at 1 for dt = 0.01, 0.001 and 1e-4. Pinned by it.fails in xbSolvers.test.ts. Not stiff-only: x' = -x at dt 0.5 also freezes (first step rejected). The worker path keeps the state at 1 but publishes a stale trial output (-0.044) - checked again in WP-14.

AC_MOTOR_PID_CONTROL with defaults settles at omega = w_ref / P = 78.5 rad/s for w_ref = 157 (stator frequency fixed at w_ref, P = 2), so the PID never removes the speed error, its integral winds up and last_e is never updated (verifier analysis; rk4, ode45 and euler 1e-5 agree). Replaces the WP-08 note.

Canvas (stepLiveSolver) and worker fall back to explicit Euler for any unknown solver name, silently; the batch runner returns UNSUPPORTED_SOLVER. Decision D3: unknown names are refused. Pinned by it.fails in xbSolvers.test.ts.

DIMENSION_MISMATCH and DATA_TYPE_MISMATCH on a connection are warnings and the run continues; decision D1 (Simulink): compile errors that stop the run. Pinned by it.fails in xbDiagnostics.test.ts. Supersedes XBV-008.
An algebraic loop without a solution (y = 1 + y) emits ALGEBRAIC_LOOP_NOT_CONVERGED but the run continues every step with a meaningless value; Simulink stops. Pinned in xbEngine.test.ts.

The engine accepts malformed models silently: two drivers on one input port, two blocks with the same id, and an unknown block type (skipped as a no-op) give no compile error. The canvas may prevent some of these, but files, the agent and DOE/TRM build models directly. Pinned in xbEngine.test.ts.

Run time is quadratic in the number of blocks (1000/2000/4000-block chains: 188/435/1633 ms for 10 rk4 steps; 10 000 blocks about 22 s); gatherInputs searches the connection list per input. Pinned against a 5 s budget in xbEngine.test.ts.

Runtime diagnostics of severity error do not stop the run: a block's typed diagnostic (e.g. LOGIC_NAN_INPUT) and a block-returned error (BLOCK_RUNTIME_FAULT via result.error) are recorded but never set the engine's fatal flag (XbridgesEngine.ts ~495-517); only thrown exceptions stop. Simulink halts on errors. Pinned in xbDiagnostics.test.ts. Also: STIFF_SOLVER_* errors stop a batch run but not the canvas run (ode14x/ode23tb keep stepping to the stop time; reportError never sets the fatal flag) - pinned in xbEngine.test.ts.

DOE_MODEL fault codes EXECUTION_EXCEPTION, INVALID_GMDH_LAYERS, INVALID_TAGUCHI_LEVELS, NO_MODEL_CONFIGURED, NON_FINITE_INPUT exist only in nextState.lastFault and inside one BLOCK_RUNTIME_FAULT message; they never appear as diagnostics, and the run continues (XBV-033). Pinned in xbDiagnostics.test.ts.

Dimension checking is inactive: library factories never set port dimensions (only PT_VEHICLE_BODY_1DOF inputs do), so DIMENSION_MISMATCH cannot fire for any canvas-built model; Simulink propagates and checks dimensions. The recipe has to patch dimensions onto ports to provoke the code.

Batch variable-step runs (Solvers.runFixedStep with ode45 or ode23) hang - no result after 60 s - as soon as they bracket a Step event: Step at 0.3, 0.5 or 0.55 s with default tolerances, or at the stop time with relTol 1e-8. Fixed-step batch rk4 finishes. Used by DOE, TRM and every batch caller. Pinned with a child-process probe and a 15 s limit in xbEngine.test.ts.

Stiff-solver options (ode14x extrapolationOrder/newtonIterations, ode23tb relTol/absTol/minStep/maxStep) are not editable on the canvas; STIFF_SOLVER_INVALID_OPTION and STIFF_SOLVER_STEP_TOO_SMALL are reachable only from a batch configuration. Related to decision D3 (user tolerances).

CONSTANT_VALUE_NOT_REPRESENTABLE (a Constant value that loses precision in its data type) is a compile error that refuses the model; Simulink reports parameter precision loss as a warning by default (out-of-range overflow stays an error). Pinned in xbDiagnostics.test.ts.

In canvas simulation (main thread and worker) a state-machine variable mapped to a top-level Inport never reaches the X-Bridges model: the canvas writes the value with setSignalValue and params.value, but Inport.execute returns its own unconnected input (default 0), which overwrites it at the next evaluation (BlockDefinitions.ts ~2610). Measured: Inport override 2.5 into an Integrator for 1 s gives 0 instead of 2.5. Pinned in xbWorker.test.ts. The embedded interpreter/C path is checked in WP-16/18. Scope (verifier): this is the canvas run inside the X-Bridges workspace; a state machine running in the app uses App.tsx runAppSimulationTick -> smAppAdapter -> smInterpreter -> xbInterpreter, which WP-16/18 verify. Also: an Inport's own 'value' parameter (2.5, no override) gives 0 on the canvas. Severity lowered to S2.
WaveformGen amplitude 0 (also freq 0, offset 0) is replaced by 1/1/0 through `||` (instance of XBV-019); a 0-amplitude sine outputs a full sine. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.

The Sources 'Clock' block is a 50% square-wave pulse generator (freq parameter), not the Simulink Clock (output = simulation time); a Simulink user wiring Clock as time gets a 0/1 square wave. No block outputs t. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.
PRODUCT works on scalars only (Number(vector) = NaN); Simulink Product multiplies/divides vectors and matrices element-wise. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.

Max (element-wise, two inputs) turns NaN into 0 (Number(x) || 0): Max(NaN, -3) = 0; MATLAB max ignores NaN (-3), Simulink MinMax propagates NaN. Negative values and ties are correct. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.

Sum signs with the '|' spacer before a sign ('+|-', '|+-', '+ -') add instead of subtract: the spacer shifts the sign positions at execute time (factory strips it for the port count only). '+-|' works. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.
Sum with a single '+' input returns the vector unchanged; Simulink's single-input Sum sums the elements. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.
All 24 trigonometric/hyperbolic blocks return NaN for a vector input; Simulink Trigonometric/Math Function blocks are element-wise. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.

The canvas worker client (serializeModelForWorker) strips execute, evaluateDerivatives and ZeroCrossingFn but not updateDiscrete, so postMessage throws DataCloneError for PT_AUTOMATED_MANUAL_TRANSMISSION and PT_DUAL_CLUTCH_TRANSMISSION (worker run impossible for any model containing them). The worker engine also never re-creates updateDiscrete (XbridgesEngine.ts ~88-94), so once cloning is fixed these hybrid blocks would lose their discrete updates; WP-11 checks this with a gear-shift stimulus. Pinned (clone list) in xbWorker.test.ts. Also: after the DataCloneError the client stays inFlight (activePending is set before postMessage throws, xbridgesWorkerClient.ts ~134), so later requests queue forever.

Mean of a matrix returns the mean of all elements (3 for [1 2; 3 6]); MATLAB mean and the Simulink Mean block default (each column) give the column means [2 4]. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts. (MATLAB mean is certain; the Simulink Mean block default 'each column' is from the verifier's memory - confirm against the documentation in WP-15.)

WaveformGen Square is amp*sign(sin(...)): 0 at t = 0 and every crossing, and +amp at t = T/2 because sin(pi) = 1.2e-16; a 50 % square wave is +amp on [0, T/2), -amp on [T/2, T). Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.

VectorPow of a negative base with a non-integer exponent returns a mathjs Complex object instead of a number (e.g. (-8)^(1/3) -> {re: 1, im: 1.732}); downstream blocks receive an object. Simulink real power gives NaN (or an error). Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.
Max and Mean throw on an empty vector (mathjs 'Cannot calculate ... of an empty array'), stopping the run. Pinned in xbEquations.math.test.ts.
SubMatrix uses zero-based start/end indices (defaults 0); Simulink Submatrix uses one-based indices, so the same numbers select a different block. Pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

MUX nests vector inputs ([1, [2, 3]]) instead of concatenating them into one flat vector [1 2 3] as Simulink Mux does; downstream widths and element indices are wrong. Pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.
Switch lacks the Simulink criterion 'u2 ~= 0' (canvas offers >, <, >=, <=) and silently passes u2 for an unknown criterion. Pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

MatrixSolve (singular, inconsistent system) Inverse (singular matrix) and MatrixMul (non-conformable sizes) throw ('Solve Error: ... matrix is singular'), stopping the run instead of reporting it. Pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

findings.summary: Register with bitWidth 32 always stores 0: the mask (1 << 32) - 1 evaluates to 0 in JavaScript. Found by the WP-05 verifier; pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

findings.plan_ref: 4.2 routing / logic / bitwise / sequential / linear algebra
findings.summary: ShiftLeft/ShiftRight use JavaScript shifts, which mask the count to 5 bits: 1 << 32 = 1, 16 >> 32 = 16; a negative count gives 4 << -1 = 0. Simulink Bit Shift shifts every bit out at >= word length and shifts the other way for a negative count. Found by the WP-05 verifier; pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

Found by the WP-05 verifier; pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts. Target: a reported error (not a throw, cf. XBV-021/055).

findings.summary: Logic and bitwise blocks are scalar-only: AND([1 0],[1 1]) = true, NOT([0 1]) = false, BitwiseAND of vectors = 0; Simulink Logical/Bitwise Operator blocks are element-wise. Found by the WP-05 verifier; pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

findings.summary: DEMUX does not follow the Simulink split rule: a 3-vector into 2 outputs emits 3 values instead of [1 2] and [3] (n mod p = m: m outputs of floor(n/p)+1 elements, then p-m of floor(n/p)); a scalar into 2 outputs (p > n, a Simulink error) silently emits 1 output. Split rule from the verifier's memory of the Demux documentation - confirm in WP-15. Pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

findings.summary: MatrixSolve returns a 2x1 matrix for a 1-D b instead of x with the shape of b. Found by the WP-05 verifier; pinned in xbEquations.routing.test.ts.

INTEGRATOR_CONTINUOUS is scalar-only: vector IC [1 2] with input [1 1] stays [1 2] (Number(vector) = NaN; NUMERICAL_INSTABILITY), Simulink integrates element-wise to [2 3] at t = 1. Found by the WP-06 executor; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

INTEGRATOR (limited/reset integrator) drops a vector initial condition (Number([1 2]) || 0 = 0) and keeps a scalar state; vector integration gives 0 instead of [2 3]. Found by the WP-06 executor; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

DELAY with delay_length 0 is refused: the factory turns 0 into 1 (`||`) and compile reports DELAY_LENGTH_INVALID and PARAMETER_OUT_OF_RANGE; Simulink Delay accepts 0 as direct feedthrough. Found by the WP-06 executor; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

SATURATION is scalar-only: a vector input or vector limits give NaN (Number(array)); Simulink Saturation is element-wise with scalar or vector limits. Found by the WP-06 executor; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

A bus through UNIT_DELAY outputs scalar 0 at the first sample (IC not expanded over the bus elements), so a downstream BUS_SELECTOR raises BLOCK_RUNTIME_FAULT 'Input must be a bus signal' at t = 0. Found by the WP-06 executor; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

Engine (canvas fixed-step loop): discontinuous sources change inside a step - the rk4 stage at t + dt already sees a Step's new value, so the plain Integrator of Step(0 -> 1 at 0.5) is off by h/6 per unit jump (Step 0 -> 1 at 0.5, rk4 dt 0.1: y(0.5) = 0.016667, y(1) = 0.516667 instead of 0 and 0.5). Simulink updates block modes (Step, limits, switches) at major steps only. The limited INTEGRATOR itself has anti-windup (euler gives y(0.8) = 0 exactly); its 0.001667 = h/6 under rk4 is this engine effect. Pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts. Related: XBV-005 (zero crossings), D2. The major-step mode rule is from the verifier's memory - confirm in WP-15.

MOVING_AVERAGE starts with its window filled with the first sample (3, 6, 9, 12 -> 3, 4, 6, 9); a sliding-window average with zero initial state gives 1, 3, 6, 9. Found by the WP-06 executor; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

INTEGRATOR with an output limit under rk4 arrives below the limit: y(0.3) = 0.29833 instead of 0.3 with limit 0.3, and with limit 0.305 it sags to 0.30333 at t = 0.5 (the saturated derivative is used in the stages of the step that reaches the limit). Simulink evaluates the limit mode at major steps: y = min(t, limit) at every sample. Found by the WP-06 verifier; pinned in xbEquations.dynamics.test.ts.

notes_for_later_wps.note: From the WP-04 verifier: integer overflow per data type, Gain matrix mode (K*u; ADIA only has element-wise, which is the Simulink default), exact degree values (sind(180) = 1.2e-16, tand(90) finite), Inf in Sum, PRODUCT with a single vector input (NaN, part of XBV-042).

From the WP-05 verifier, not yet pinned: Switch scalar expansion and vector ctrl; IF_ELSE with NaN (false) and [0] (true); MatrixConcat with unequal widths returns a ragged matrix; SubMatrix clamps out-of-range ends; MatrixSolve on a rank-deficient consistent system returns one solution silently; Inverse/Determinant of a non-square matrix throw (XBV-055 family); MatrixDiag ignores diagMode (auto-detects by shape); cond 1e12/1e16; single-input XOR; clock high at step 0 counted as an edge.

From WP-06: DERIVATIVE tau 0 or negative is replaced by 0.01 (instance of XBV-019); derivative of a Step under rk4 spikes at 83.3 (step seen at the mid stage of the previous step) - compare with Simulink Derivative in WP-15; INTERP_PRELOOKUP default table differs from LOOKUP_ND default; Flat/Nearest lookup require ExtrapMethod 'Clip' (linear extrapolation rejected) - check against Simulink.
